shared_elements: standing human figures in profile arranged in file
men leading/handling animals by rein or tether
procession moving in a single direction
justification: Both depict continuous low-relief friezes of profile human figures marching in file, overlapping one another, with bearded men leading or attending horses and carrying long shafted implements, rendered in a comparably detailed, semi-naturalistic profile convention. The biggest difference in content is subject: A is a peaceable multi-register procession of delegations bearing gifts and led animals, while B shows a martial scene with archers drawing bows, armed spearmen and a wheeled chariot, elements entirely absent from A.
